name: Pooja R. Sonar
tagline: Dynamic Software Developer specializing in scalable, user-centric solutions across real-time systems, MERN stack, and AI-powered platforms.
about: Pooja R. Sonar is a highly skilled Software Developer with proven expertise in architecting and deploying real-time telemetry systems, crafting scalable web applications, and integrating advanced AI-driven solutions. Her comprehensive experience spans full-stack development, leveraging modern technologies such as Next.js, React, Node.js, and MongoDB to optimize front-end performance and user experience. She excels at designing intuitive user interfaces, implementing secure authentication protocols, and ensuring robust system reliability through message-driven architectures and microservices. Beyond her technical prowess, Pooja is a recognized leader, having achieved top placements in competitive hackathons and actively contributing to technical communities.
highlights: Architected real-time telemetry (10K+ readings/min) via Cosmos DB change feed + Node.js; achieved 99.9% uptime.
Integrated Socket.IO WebSockets + MQTT to serve 500+ farms with <100ms UI latency.
Built Next.js (TypeScript) + Redux dashboards for 50+ sensor cards, anomalies, alerts; <200ms refresh.
Implemented SSE fallback with exponential backoff (98% reconnect) and per-farm isolation for 100+ farms.
Built and maintained scalable web applications using Next.js and TypeScript, optimized front-end performance and UX.
Secured 3rd place in Hackathon organized by GDSC ADGITM.
Represented as Goa State Chess Player.

projects.name: AccessAI - CodeQuest (MERN)
projects.description: Developed an innovative, AI-powered gamified coding preparation platform. This MERN stack application facilitates user learning of various programming languages through interactive challenges, offering intelligent, AI-driven assistance leveraging Gemini's API.

projects.name: Chess.com Backend Clone (MERN)
projects.description: Designed and implemented a comprehensive backend clone of Chess.com using the MERN stack. This system accurately mimics chess gameplay, featuring real-time synchronization powered by Socket.IO WebSockets and robust RESTful APIs incorporating advanced security measures.
